## What's Changed
* feat: add /duck dialogue command by @zhek in https://github.com/zhek/opencode-ducksay/pull/24
* feat: add easter egg by @zhek in https://github.com/zhek/opencode-ducksay/pull/25
* docs: move the dialogue section above install by @zhek in https://github.com/zhek/opencode-ducksay/pull/26
* chore: release 1.4.0 by @zhek in https://github.com/zhek/opencode-ducksay/pull/27


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/zhek/opencode-ducksay/compare/v1.3.0...v1.4.0

## What's Changed
* docs: move the version bump out of ordinary pull requests by @zhek in https://github.com/zhek/opencode-ducksay/pull/10
* docs: correct two claims about the sidebar by @zhek in https://github.com/zhek/opencode-ducksay/pull/11
* feat: show a speech bubble when the duck rests by @zhek in https://github.com/zhek/opencode-ducksay/pull/12
* feat: add LLM rest jokes by @zhek in https://github.com/zhek/opencode-ducksay/pull/13
* feat: show the duck thinking and typing at rest by @zhek in https://github.com/zhek/opencode-ducksay/pull/14
* feat: show a question marker while the duck waits for an answer by @zhek in https://github.com/zhek/opencode-ducksay/pull/15
* docs: commit specs and archives with docs prefix by @zhek in https://github.com/zhek/opencode-ducksay/pull/16
* feat: tune the duck's pace and keep each session's duck separate by @zhek in https://github.com/zhek/opencode-ducksay/pull/17
* feat: decouple duck speech from swim speed by @zhek in https://github.com/zhek/opencode-ducksay/pull/18
* docs: translate the configuration reference into Russian by @zhek in https://github.com/zhek/opencode-ducksay/pull/19
* chore: add MIT license, package metadata and a shorter README by @zhek in https://github.com/zhek/opencode-ducksay/pull/20
* docs: enable the plugin per project by @zhek in https://github.com/zhek/opencode-ducksay/pull/21
* docs: point the README documentation links at GitHub by @zhek in https://github.com/zhek/opencode-ducksay/pull/22
* chore: release 1.3.0 by @zhek in https://github.com/zhek/opencode-ducksay/pull/23


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/zhek/opencode-ducksay/compare/v1.2.0...v1.3.0

## What's Changed
* docs: require a version bump to land in every artifact by @zhek in https://github.com/zhek/opencode-ducksay/pull/7
* docs: keep implementation detail out of the user-facing documents by @zhek in https://github.com/zhek/opencode-ducksay/pull/8
* feat: put the duck in the water by @zhek in https://github.com/zhek/opencode-ducksay/pull/9


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/zhek/opencode-ducksay/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0

## What's Changed
* docs: set project conventions for OpenSpec and git by @zhek in https://github.com/zhek/opencode-ducksay/pull/1
* docs: update branch naming and commit format conventions by @zhek in https://github.com/zhek/opencode-ducksay/pull/2
* docs: require SHALL in spec requirements by @zhek in https://github.com/zhek/opencode-ducksay/pull/3
* docs: archive changes inside the PR by @zhek in https://github.com/zhek/opencode-ducksay/pull/4
* feat: add the Ducksay section to the session sidebar by @zhek in https://github.com/zhek/opencode-ducksay/pull/5
